profile.headline: Software Engineer at All Covered
profile.summary: Experienced full-stack .NET developer with experience working in many facets of software development. During my career I have created complex .NET Core services, architected and maintained Xamarin Forms enterprise mobile applications and designed website experiences in Angular that tens of thousands of users used on a daily basis. On top of my engineering responsibilities I had to create CI-CD pipelines that ensured reliable and consistent code was released to production with 99% uptime in both Jenkins and Azure DevOps. This metric was ensured by writing thorough unit tests and using industry leading code analysis tools such as SonarQube.

company.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona

positions.title: Programmer III
positions.description:
● Designed and deployed enterprise .NET 3.1 and .NET 6 APIs that were used by hundreds of thousands of members.
● Drove communications and requirement extraction for integrating with vendor SSOs.
● Worked closely with product owners to write user stories. This included discovering requirements, creating acceptance criteria, identified blockers and including important information for developers.
● Troubleshot and deployed fixes to Azure Devops and Jenkins pipelines to clear blockers for sprint work. 
● Setup monitoring solutions through Azure Application insights to ensure rapid response to system outages.

positions.title: Programmer ll
positions.description:
● Member of Developer Community of Practice to ensure all development teams were following a
consistent high level of standards and technologies across the organization.
● Wrote developer documentation used by digital teams to review and enforce best practices used in Developer Community of Practice. 
● Implemented SonarQube auditing tool to maintain consistency and quality across applications.
● Helped enforce unit test coverage metric of 90% on all new projects. Personal contributions to this included code reviews of tests and implementing SonarQube scans that auto failed builds if code coverage was not met.
● Mentored and trained new developers and automation developers by creating documentation
and knowledge sharing internal processes.
● Created .NET Microservices by translating and breaking down key application components to
replace monolith applications.
● Coordinated with release and operations teams for releasing code to production and sanity
testing applications after code releases were completed.

positions.title: Programmer I
positions.description:
● Joined Blue Cross Blue Shield’s first successful pilot Agile team that helped build a culture for
the rest of the development teams at BCBSAZ to base their teams new workflows from.
● Architected and built new company websites and APIs written in Angular with .Net core backend.
● Designed and built a new member mobile app that received a 2000% increase in active user
sessions over the legacy applications active sessions.
● Implemented CI-CD pipelines in Azure DevOps using YAML for builds and releases. This included
running unit tests, smoke tests and SonarQube scans for changes made to projects.
● Worked with Scrum Masters and product owners in an Agile Scrum workflow to write user
stories and acceptance criteria.
● Presented technical information to team stakeholders to transparently communicate team
objectives that were accomplished in the previous sprint.

positions.title: NOC Intern
positions.description: Help with day to day tasks in Limelights Network Operation Center. Some of my tasks included writing automation scripts, Remote Hands process and properly bringing new hardware into service for limelight's global network.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Helping web developers of LABOV with front-end design of websites and projects using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Also attended company meetings and helped with various jobs around the office.
